5 days in Iceland, I mainly want photography.

ITINERARY

DESTINATION   Iceland
DURATION      5 days
INTENSITY     High

DAY 01        Reykjanes peninsula
DAY 02        Golden Circle
DAY 03        South coast, Seljalandsfoss to Vik
DAY 04        Jokulsarlon and Diamond Beach
DAY 05        Return west

WHY
Driving east puts the best light at the far end of the trip.

Compare Da Nang and Nha Trang.

COMPARISON

DA NANG       Better base. Hoi An and Marble Mountains within an hour.
NHA TRANG     Better beach, less around it, busier waterfront.

RECOMMENDATION
Da Nang if you want to leave the beach at some point. Nha Trang if the
beach is the whole plan.
